title: Transfer: clean a names log

blocks.md:
## Scrub a messy file

`messy.txt` has blank lines, extra spaces, and the same name twice. `clean(text)` trims each line, drops empties, keeps each name once, then sorts.

Print the cleaned text. Unique sorted names: `east`, then `north`, then `west` on the last line. The hidden test will send a shorter list (`b`, `a`, `b`) and expect `a` then `b`.

Two `north` slips on the desk become one `north` line. The fox heading list should not repeat a name because someone typed it twice.

blocks.promptMd: After trim and drop blanks, make names {{a}}, then {{b}} them.
blocks.explainMd: Set keeps each name once. sort puts east before north before west.
